title: Genies for Fire and Security Service Handoffs: Assemble Inspection, Asset, and Service-Agreement Evidence
summary: Use Genies to assemble fire and security service context while keeping technical and commercial decisions with their owners.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A fire and security handoff Genie can gather inspection references, installed-asset context, service-agreement coverage and open follow-up records into a review packet. Require it to cite the source for each association and distinguish verified facts from missing or conflicting evidence. Its role is administrative preparation and routing. It should not certify an inspection, choose a technical remedy, determine compliance, or authorize remedial work based on a plausible-looking match.


Explore the complete[fire, life-safety and security integrators integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fire-life-safety-security-integrators) for the systems and processes around this guide.
